biotools.summary: RT-GSCS is a web-based, open-source tool designed for real-time spatial surveys using Real-Time Spatial Delphi logic for consensus building. It supports decision-making processes and territorial actions, especially when spatial data is lacking or user judgments are required.
biotools.name: Real-Time Geo-Spatial Consensus System (RT-GSCS)
